title: Thucydides, History of the Peloponnesian War 3.89 (English, Richard Crawley, 1874)

source.license: Public domain (Crawley died 1893; Project Gutenberg text)

summary: Thucydides on the earthquakes and tidal waves of 426 BCE, including the wave that struck Atalanta off the Locrian coast. A first-hand ancient account of a quake-driven sea wave on the Greek coast, with his own explanation of the cause.

tree.title: Thucydides 3.89: earthquakes, and the sea wave at Orobiae and Atalanta (426 BCE)
tree.summary: The Peloponnesian invasion of Attica turns back because of earthquakes. At Orobiae in Euboea the sea retreats and returns in a huge wave, flooding part of the town. A similar flood hits the island of Atalanta. Thucydides concludes the cause is the earthquake driving back the sea.
